purpose: Canonical full-replay test of stationary-only weak opposing-reversal authority and extended opposition-qualified risk.
invariant: Production architecture 0 remained unchanged. Mode 17 inherited mode 16 camera-aware disocclusion and changed weak repetition/risk lifetime only while scene-level motion was absent.
interpretation: Mode 17 is directionally successful but rejected: stationary weak-reversal handling raises the perceptual floor from -0.0117 to 0.102 without materially worsening motion or clearing, and fixes the prior red-full failure, but 5 Hz/7.5 Hz quarter-field luminance still fails WCAG. Inspection shows the raw disocclusion reset can erase already-qualified risk/prime before the stationary extension runs, motivating a state-only corrected-disocclusion test.
evidence_serialization: Repository copies are UTF-8 LF JSON serializations of the artifact JSON values.
